address: 5B Phu Doan Street, Hang Trong Ward, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi, 100000, Vietnam
bio: The chicken noodle come with a variety of chicken cuts, but the tender thigh is a favourite – perfect in both soup and dry noodle dishes. Mix and match thigh and wings or wings and breast, adding condiments to taste. Open until midnight, it’s a popular late-night spot....
